_doc: Shadower skill definitions (spec #425). Empty until the skill tickets land; each appends inside its own region, and a key may be defined in one file only (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md 4.4.4). SH6 #431 moves Double Stab, Steal and Savage Blow here from skills/thief.json (ported, no explicit ranks); SH7 #432 Assaulter (mobility); SH8 #433 Boomerang Step and Band of Thieves; SH9 #434 Ninja Ambush (key ninja_ambush_shadower); SH10 #435 Meso Explosion; SH11 #436 Dark Sight (moved from skills/thief.json and rewritten as a hidden Form) and Assassinate (form_sub); SH12 #437 Smokescreen (safe_zone). The pool is in jobs/shadower.json.

dark_sight.name: Dark Sight
dark_sight.desc: Vanish from sight for a few seconds, then strike from the shadows.

text.desc: Vanish for a few seconds: monsters ignore you, nothing can hit you and every attack except Assassinate is silenced. Assassinate ambushes one monster at a time.

dark_sight._provenance: Tier A: Skill.wz 4001003 speed (-30 to 0 over 20 levels; the eight mapped levels 3/5/8/10/13/15/18/20 read -26 -22 -16 -12 -7 -5 -2 0, so rank 1 / 4 / 8 is -26 / -12 / 0), the darksight action, the 4-frame effect and the Use sound; mpCon and the session-scale WZ time (30 to 200 s) are not read. Tier C (spec #425 SH-4, SH-6, SH11 #436): rewritten from the passive-slot buff that auto-cast below 30% HP into a pool Form of the exclusive group shadower_stance, a 5 s Hidden window (the literal buff.duration), admitted when a living mob is within 150 px, 20 s cooldown (25% uptime), carrying Assassinate (first cast 0.8 s in, then every 2.0 s); the 50% avatar alpha of 7.23 stays; the rarity bonuses. Docs: GAME_DESIGN 7.131 and 7.135.

assassinate.name: Assassinate
assassinate.desc: Strike a monster three times from the shadows; the last strike may be a lethal critical.

text.desc: While Dark Sight hides you, you strike the nearest monster three times; the last strike may be a lethal critical.

assassinate._provenance: Tier A: Skill.wz 4221001 damage 230 / 425 / 600 % at WZ levels 4 / 15 / 30 (= 5 x the String percent), attackCount 3 (the String says 4; the node is used), mobCount 1, prop 38 / 60 / 90 and criticalDamage 120 / 175 / 250 (read through finish_strike), the canonical box lt (-100,-120) rb (-10,0), the assassination action (top-level action/0 and effect/action), the 25-frame effect, the 10-frame special, and the Use and Use2 sounds (UOLs into 4121001). The WZ time and accumulative damage are not modelled. Tier C (spec #425 SH-5, SH-7, SH11 #436): a Form sub of Dark Sight with no slot and no card, ranking with its parent through its own 30-level table (Dark Sight rank 8 casts level 30), one box cast on at least one target (a scheduled boss first, then the nearest), the last line a critical on prop with criticalDamage points (FinishingStrike), the full 1.9 s assassination stance held (under the 2.0 s interval), the special art drawn as the hit on each line, Use and Use2 alternating per cast. Docs: GAME_DESIGN 7.133 and 7.135.

_sh11_region: SH11 #436 owns dark_sight and assassinate (the last two keys); other tickets append their own entries above them.
